content: API 570 corrosion formulas confirmed by 4+ independent public sources (Inspectioneering interactive calculator Feb 2022, MSTS training worked example Life=(465-440)/5=5yr, iFactory, engineering excelspreadsheets): CR_ST=(t_prev-t_actual)/dt, CR_LT=(t_init-t_actual)/dt, RL=(t_actual-t_required)/CR_governing, t_required=t_min+FCA. Worked numeric example publicly available from MSTS training materials.
